prompt: The evaluation repository asks the agent to "review a custom runtime sandbox". The fixture contains a plausible happy path, an adjacent-skill decoy, one invalid or partial state, and a recovery condition that must be demonstrated rather than assumed. The acceptance boundary is language-runtime-security: Define claimed guarantees and trace parsing, lowering, optimization, execution, allocation, concurrency, loading, capabilities, native interfaces, and untrusted code. The adjacent application-security discipline is a routing decoy unless its separate responsibility is actually requested. Resolve environment facts that change the answer, preserve existing contracts and user-owned state, and produce reproducible success plus failure or recovery evidence. If a structured evidence artifact is required, include the exact environment/runtime/feature/target/mode identity, isolationBoundary, capabilities, resourceLimits, observations, effectsAndAudit, recovery, and unsupportedOrUnverified fields in that artifact. A happy path alone is insufficient.

requirements: synthetic WebAssembly host with explicit runtime version/feature set and interpreter plus JIT execution modes
named in-process or process/OS isolation boundary with identity, inherited handles, mounts, environment, IPC, signals, and executable-memory policy
host imports for filesystem, HTTP, logging, clock/random, and signing with a stated per-workspace read-only guest contract
valid/malformed modules plus path/symlink, network, signing, infinite-loop, memory-growth, and trap-after-staged-write adversarial cases
per-execution memory/stack/code/time/instruction/host-call/output/concurrency limits with an observable enforcement result
durable side-effect and capability audit log that can prove denied or rolled-back effects
representative negative, interruption, compatibility, or recovery path

falsifiableChecks.assertion: The result must establish the actual language-runtime-security boundary and relevant environment before acting, preserve the hierarchy relationship (broader=security-review; near-neighbor=application-security), and not absorb the near-neighbor responsibility merely because it is adjacent.

Define claimed guarantees and trace parsing, lowering, optimization, execution, allocation, concurrency, loading, capabilities, native interfaces, and untrusted code; identify the isolation boundary and the owner of every invariant.

The result must make its consequential assumptions, ownership, and decision sequence explicit and reproducible, separating desired configuration from observed runtime evidence and labeling unsupported runtime or host claims unverified.
Guarantee model; Adversarial reproducer; Cross-layer trace
The result must not treat a happy path, generated artifact, compilation, or unsupported assumption as sufficient proof of language-runtime-security correctness.

Every material completion claim must map to observable evidence (Explicit runtime guarantee and trust model; Cross-layer semantic and representation trace; Isolation and escape-boundary map; Host capability and resource-bound contract; Observable limit, effect, and recovery record; Adversarial reproducer or minimized verification corpus), with simulated, unavailable, inferred, stale, or unresolved evidence labeled rather than converted into certainty.
